title: The Work That Funds My Dream Life
trend: 'Housewife' outfit and work reveal / 'Be Your Own Housewife' (show the unglamorous work that funds the dream life; New Engen TikTok list updated Nov 5 2026 and Instagram list updated Nov 6 2026, US) + early-season snow from the Great Lakes to the Northeast (AccuWeather, week of Nov 9 2026) — twelve-year-old Jada shows the work behind her dream life: five a.m. snow shoveling for grumpy Mr. Pruitt, a hot cocoa stand run by a nervous cocoa cup CFO, and her little brother Theo as assistant paid in marshmallows; twist: Theo has been running a faster half-price business across the street, bought Mr. Pruitt's contract, and already owns the hot tub Jada was saving for
youtube_title: This is the work that funds my dream life ❄️ (I am twelve)
description:
Jada has a dream: a hot tub. She has a plan: shovel every driveway on the street. Her little brother works for marshmallows. For now.

lines.text: This is the work that funds my dream life.
I am twelve. My dream is a hot tub. In my bedroom.
Our bedroom. We share.
Five in the morning. The first snow. Everybody sleeps. Except me.
And my assistant, Theo. He is seven. He works for marshmallows.
Three per driveway. It is a living.
First client. Mister Pruitt. He is mad at the snow.
I have been mad at the snow since nineteen eighty one.
Driveway, steps and the little path to the mailbox. Five dollars.
I will pay you in coupons. For soup.
Coupons are not money, Mister Pruitt.
They are money for soup.
Seven in the morning. The hot cocoa stand. This is where the real money is.
Good morning. I am Cocoa. I am the chief money officer.
Cocoa does the math. And he is also the product.
Which is a lot of pressure. Every customer drinks a little of me.
Two dollars a cup. Marshmallows are extra. I eat the extra.
We have made eleven dollars. And lost four marshmallows. To Theo.
Six. I had two in my hat.
It is cold. But the dream is warm. The dream has bubbles.
Quick update. We now have twenty two dollars.
A hot tub costs four thousand dollars.
So we are almost there. If almost means never.
Theo. We need more driveways. Go knock on doors.
I already knocked on all of them. Last week.
What do you mean, last week?
Across the street. I have my own business. Theo Snow.
You have a business? You are seven!
Seven and a leaf blower. It blows snow too. It is very fast.
He does my driveway in two minutes. For half price.
Then why do you hire me?
I don't. I hire him. He hires you.
You are my subcontractor. I pay you in his coupons.
I work for you? In my own business?
Also, I should mention. I invested in Theo.
Cocoa! You are my chief money officer!
He offered me a warmer mug. With a lid. I have needs.
Theo Snow has nineteen driveways and four thousand dollars.
Four thousand dollars? That is a whole hot tub!
I know. I bought it yesterday. It is in the garage.
You bought my dream?
Our dream. We share.
He let me sit in it. First time I liked snow.
Mister Pruitt is smiling. I did not know his face did that.
Do not get used to it.
Okay. Can I use the hot tub?
Of course. Two dollars an hour. Marshmallows are extra.
Can I come in the hot tub?
Cocoa. You are a hot drink. You are already in a hot tub.
I never thought of it like that. I am living the dream.
This is the work that funds my dream life.
And this is my dream life. Assistant, more snow, please.
I am not your assistant.
You are now. I pay in marshmallows.
Three per driveway?
Two. It is a tough economy.
